topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The thought of losing you to a distance so vast that only planes and long, winding roads can bridge it... It's like staring into a gap that keeps widening, a chasm that threatens to swallow the ease of our laughter and the shared silences we've cherished. Every word we exchange now seems to echo with a finality I can't reconcile. I find myself searching for things to say, not because there’s a lack of words, but because every sentence feels too small, too insignificant against the enormity of what’s to come. The idea of you being so far away turns the familiar corners of my world into stark, unfamiliar landscapes. Yet, I cling to the hope that this isn't the end, just a pause—a long, lonely pause.
